test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(8, 4, 1)

(12, 4, 5)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**(1st number - 2nd number) - 3 = 3rd number**.

Here, for (8, 4, 1)

(8 - 4) - 3

⇒ 4 - 3 = 1.

(12, 4, 5)

(12 - 4) - 3

⇒ 8 - 3 = 5.

Similarly, for **(17, 8, 6)**

**(17 - 8) - 3**

**⇒ 9 - 3 = 6.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
